description: Use this when you need web pages on a topic and do not have a URL yet. Returns up to `limit` results (1-25), each with its URL, title and description. Set scrape_results to true to also get each result page's content as markdown in the same call (each scraped page costs extra credits); otherwise pass the URLs you need to scrape_website, or to batch_scrape_urls for many. Use include_domains to search one site. For a direct factual answer with sources, use answers.

exclude_domains.description: Never return results from these domains.

include_domains.description: Only return results from these domains, e.g. ["docs.olostep.com"].

limit.description: Number of results to return, from 1 to 25. Default: 10.

max_characters.description: With scrape_results, the maximum characters of content returned per page. Default: 20000.

scrape_results.description: Also scrape each result and return its content as markdown. Each scraped page uses extra credits.

name: search_web
title: Search Web
